certified_lower_bound.selection: row echelon modulo p=2^61-1 (exact integer arithmetic); determinant exact (Bareiss) and re-checked

machine_certificate.logic: Each deleted angle is globally inactive (transported generator P with [Omega,P(x)I+I(x)P]=0, exact Pauli algebra). Each virtual field v(theta) obeys J(theta)v(theta)=0 for all theta (SymPy Euler identity + exact two-copy invariance of the transported inserted generator). Family rank m at theta* is <= its generic rank, so generic r <= K-m (analyticity).

upper_bound.manuscript_reference: manuscript_theory_reference/family_extension.tex, subsection "An all-size Kyriienko-type upper bound", Eq. (kyrifamilyupper): r <= 3n-2 for Eq. (kyriform) with independent local Euler blocks, entangler commuting with Z_0 and X_{n-1}, isotropic local XYZ or complete weight<=k (k<n) readout; see also fourier_gram.tex Sec. "Closing the three Kyriienko intervals".

exact_consistency_at_theta_star.note: one-point consistency (rank at theta* equals the certified generic value), not an extra proof

numerical_not_certified.label: NOT a certificate (floating SVD / random-point residuals)
numerical_not_certified.note: relative residual ||J v|| / (max(||J||_F, max d^2) ||v||); controls are perturbed fields that should NOT be null (they are null only when J itself vanishes)

timing_note: exact states/features are computed once per n for the union (weight<=2) readout and cached; exact_states_total_cache is cumulative and is charged to the first readout processed at that n
